metadata.description: Thinking-partner toolkit built from Anand Vengurlekar's workshop on wisdom, learning velocity and AI as a thinking partner.

plugins.name: anand-thinking-tools
plugins.description: Six tools that raise your own thinking instead of replacing it: dual-column wisdom notes, question-storming, Paul and Elder critical-thinking review, four-stage incubation, reading with AI (Adler plus Feynman), and eleven narrative structures with a storyboard-first rule.
